intro.text: The rules anyone in the Forests of Hell must follow to keep from drawing the shades' notice. Those who break them are usually killed quickly.

description.text: Nobody knows where the rules came from or exactly how they work, not even the Forescouts, the forest's first settlers. Breaking one does not always mean death, but escaping the shades afterwards is very hard.

Each rule broken stirs the shades differently. Blood sends them into a rage at once, while running draws them only slowly; fire brings them straight away but also dazzles and confuses them. Fortfolk are thought to be less careful about the rules than homesteaders.
Inside a ring of silver the rules can be broken without bringing shades, though it is wiser not to try. Legend says the White Fox could ignore them, because no shade would dare come for that soul.
